name: 3rd party - warehouse
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose 3rd party - warehouse.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.content: Product template only. Curated merchandising; shipping and warehouse availability are managed outside this section. Add Warehouse mapping blocks to connect codes to collections. Up to the first 50 collection products are inspected.

settings.label: Kicker
settings.how: Add a short line of text. Use the available emphasis and link tools; this field is intended for inline content.

settings.label: Heading
settings.how: Add a short line of text. Use the available emphasis and link tools; this field is intended for inline content.

settings.label: Body
settings.default: Browse this curated collection of related products.
settings.how: Use the rich text editor for paragraphs, lists, emphasis, and links. Use descriptive link text and headings in a logical order.

settings.label: Source mode
settings.info: Auto: product fulfillment.warehouse metaobject with code and collection, then Warehouse mapping blocks by fulfillment.warehouse_code or warehouse:CODE tag. First matching block wins.
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for source mode. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Force collection (used when source mode = force collection)
settings.how: Choose an existing collection. Manage its products, title, image, and description under Products > Collections.

settings.label: Fallback collection (used when no warehouse match found)
settings.how: Choose an existing collection. Manage its products, title, image, and description under Products > Collections.

settings.label: Hide if no results
settings.how: Turn on “Hide if no results” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Empty message (only shown if hide if no results = false)
settings.default: No related products are available right now.
settings.how: Add a short line of text. Use the available emphasis and link tools; this field is intended for inline content.

settings.label: Max products
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust max products. Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Layout variant
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for layout variant. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Columns (desktop)
settings.how: Drag the control to adjust columns (desktop). Use only the range and increments shown below. Preview at mobile and desktop widths after changing spacing or dimensions.

settings.label: Show mapped group chip
settings.info: Labels the curated mapped collection. Forced and fallback collections have no group chip. This does not verify inventory or combined shipping.
settings.how: Turn on “Show mapped group chip” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Chip position
settings.how: Choose one of the supported options below for chip position. Only the selected option applies; other settings can further customize its appearance.

settings.label: Use custom colors
settings.how: Turn on “Use custom colors” to apply that behavior. Turn it off to remove that behavior. Other settings can affect whether the result is visible; check the section preview after changing it.

settings.label: Background color
settings.how: Choose a color for background color. Check the paired background or text color: body text needs readable contrast, including hover and focus states.

settings.info: Matches the current product code, ignoring case and surrounding spaces.
settings.how: Enter the warehouse code. Replace sample wording with your own content; leave optional fields empty when you do not need them.
